# Nearby Drop

> Nearby Drop (the NearByDrop GitHub project) is an independent native macOS menu bar app by Arslan Basharat for transferring files between Mac and Android using Quick Share, QR codes, USB MTP, and Finder sharing. It is separate from NearDrop by grishka.

## Verified facts

- Current public release: Nearby Drop v2.3.4.
- Supports macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon and Intel.
- Free to download; proprietary license.
- Wireless transfers use a reachable local network and do not use a cloud relay. USB MTP uses a direct cable.
- The app is independent and is not affiliated with Google or Apple.
- Device verification notes identify tested devices, release-build limitations, and unverified network cases. Do not imply universal compatibility.
- The current download is ad hoc signed and not notarized; macOS may show a Gatekeeper warning.
